correctness.rationale: The finite abelian character group H is generated by coordinate weights a,b. The frozen RESULT.md supplies the signed Euler-form translation expression Q=1/2 Σ_h[(x_h-x_(h+a))²+(x_h-x_(h+b))²−(x_h-x_(h+a+b))²], whose zero Fourier modes are exactly characters annihilating a or b or sending a+b to −1. Characters in both annihilators are only the trivial one; intersection of the coset with each annihilator has one character iff its order is even. Inclusion–exclusion yields d_a+d_b−1−epsilon_a−epsilon_b+(d_c if ord(c) even else 0), and nullity one iff H cyclic, a,b generators, ord(a+b) odd. I independently computed 1,157 faithful small cyclic/bicyclic group profiles via modular character evaluation; finite tests are corroborative, not proof of universal duality or that the imported Euler-form formula has its claimed normalization.
